name: cartograph-mcp

tools.name: cg_registry
tools.description: Registry-facing daily workflow for Cartograph widgets and blueprints. Use search before writing reusable logic, inspect before installing or editing, install to add a widget to the current project, and rate to leave registry feedback. When installing or inspecting, use the exact value from the 'id' field returned by search.

registry.description: Restrict search fan-out to the given registry prefixes (e.g. ['cg'], ['myorg', 'cg']). Without this, all configured registries are searched.

owner.description: Filter search to widgets owned by @handle. Requires registry (owner is scoped per-registry).

local_only.description: Search only the local library; skip all registry calls. Cannot combine with registry/owner.

widget_id.description: Widget ID. Use the exact value from the 'id' field returned by search.

all_versions.description: Include all historical versions for inspect.

widget_ref.description: Widget dir path or @handle/widget-id for rate.

tools.name: cg_installed
tools.description: Mutate widgets already installed in the current project. Use this for installed copies only; use cg_registry install for adding a new widget. Actions: upgrade requires widget_dir and optionally version; uninstall requires widget_dir. Pass the widget directory path (e.g. cg/backend-retry-python).

widget_dir.description: The local widget directory path (e.g. cg/backend-retry-python).

tools.name: cg_status
tools.description: Check health/status for installed widgets in the current project. Use this to see if widgets are out of sync with the library, have local modifications, or have updates available. Omit widget_dir to scan all installed widgets; provide a specific directory (e.g. cg/backend-retry-python) to inspect one.

widget_dir.description: Installed widget directory (e.g. cg-infra-agent-cli-python) or path; omit to scan all.

tools.name: cg_create
tools.description: Scaffold a new Cartograph widget or blueprint. Use name for the slug only, not the full widget_id; Cartograph combines domain + name + language for widgets. For blueprints, just use the name.

is_blueprint.description: Whether to scaffold a blueprint instead of a widget.

target.description: Project root to create the module under.

tools.name: cg_validate
tools.description: Run the full preflight / smoke pipeline without checking the module into the library. Use this as the dry run for checkin before recording reusable changes.

path.description: Module directory (e.g. cg/backend-retry-python) or ID with lib=true.

lib.description: Treat path as a library widget ID.

tools.name: cg_checkin
tools.description: Run the full validation / smoke pipeline and then check the module into the library. Use this only for changes that should become reusable logic. Requires reason. Supports either path or widget_dir for compatibility.

tools.name: cg_blueprint
tools.description: Blueprint-specific composition management. Blueprints are higher-order widgets that compose other widgets as dependencies. Use this to add or remove dependencies.

widget_id.description: Widget ID to add or remove as a dependency.

tools.name: cg_config
tools.description: Read or update Cartograph workflow defaults. Provide key to read the current value; provide both key and value to update it.

key.description: Configuration key to read or update. Omit to list all settings.

tools.name: cg_rules
tools.description: List or manage custom validation rules that run during Cartograph validate and checkin.

scope.description: Whether to target project rules or global rules. Defaults to project.

tools.name: cg_help
tools.description: Recovery guidance for common Cartograph trouble states (e.g. local out of sync with cloud, checkin blocked, validation contamination, publish rejected). Use action=list to browse topics with one-line summaries, then action=get with a topic to read the full resolution. Reach for this before guessing when an agent is stuck on a Cartograph error state.

action.description: list returns available topics; get returns the full entry for one topic.

topic.description: Topic slug for action=get (from the list output).

instructions:
Cartograph preserves reusable implementation work across projects as widgets and blueprints. Reusable means code, logic, tests, examples, models, geometry, hardware modules, or patterns that would be useful in another project, not just another file in the current project.

Use this MCP for the Cartograph daily-driver surface: registry interaction, installed-widget management, project widget status, widget creation, widget validation, widget checkin, widget rating, custom validation rules, and core workflow config.

This MCP is intentionally not the full Cartograph CLI. For commands or options not exposed here, use the shell and run `cartograph --help` or `cartograph <command> --help`. The CLI is the source of truth for the complete command surface.

When creating widgets through this MCP, pass only the widget slug as `name`; Cartograph composes the full widget_id from `domain`, `name`, and `language`. Installed widgets normally live under `cg/<widget_id>/`.
